answer: Limit each new identity to a small reward share until unrelated peers validate random samples of its work. Group accounts that repeatedly use the same reviewers or source records and count the group as one participant; a comet-like burst of linked claims can trigger a temporary hold. Reviewers can trace pigment in an image to its source file or check whether a delivery route was allowed to wander beyond its logged corridor. Attackers must produce distinct evidence and maintain independent histories, not just create keys.
